title: Claude Code Sandbox: Stop It Reading Your SSH Keys
description:
Your AI agent can read your whole disk, unless you wall it in. 🔒

✅ Turn on the sandbox in settings.json
✅ Block retries outside the sandbox
✅ Deny reading your SSH keys

Day 4 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 5: Review Every Diff Before You Commit.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #claudecode #aicoding #aiagents #aisecurity #sandbox #programming
comment: Sandbox or hooks: which would you turn on first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: on Linux and WSL2 the sandbox needs bubblewrap and socat installed, and native Windows is not supported.
